overall_summary: Dataset is small with low view counts overall, yielding low statistical confidence. However, 'self respect' combined with modern, hyper-specific digital touchpoints (like status views, blue ticks, and chat lists) shows relative outperformance compared to generic relationship or midnight overthinking hooks.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'जब रिप्लाई का इंतज़ार खत्म हो जाए' (34 views), 'चैट डिलीट करने की हिम्मत' (41 views), and status-list views (41 views) outperform generic heartbroken themes.
winning_patterns.action: Focus on tactical modern UI interaction moments (hiding status, muting chats, removing pinned items).

weak_patterns.evidence: Hooks like 'रात के दो बजे' (13 views) and 'मेज पर रखी चाय ठंडी हो गई' (6 views) show lower traction.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid vague poetic time-of-night tropes; anchor the story in immediate micro-actions.

next_video.concept: Noticing someone typing for a long time and finally closing the app instead of waiting for the message.
next_video.opening_direction: जब स्क्रीन पर 'typing...' का ग्रीन इंडिकेटर फ्लैश हुआ,

next_video.reason: Mid-day posting slots have historically captured slightly better early baseline traffic in this dataset, and typing indicators are highly relatable modern triggers.
